stage3_pentest_findings.attack_category: High-Concurrency SQLite Write Lock Contention (1,000-User Burst)
stage3_pentest_findings.adversarial_payload: 1,000 concurrent threads calling POST /api/hitl/submit & /api/hitl/decision simultaneously
stage3_pentest_findings.pre_hardening_behavior: Default SQLite journal mode without WAL or RLock synchronization caused transient SQLITE_BUSY lock contention and P95 latency spikes under 1,000-user parallel write bursts.
stage3_pentest_findings.post_hardening_behavior: Enabled PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL, PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL, busy_timeout=30000ms, and a re-entrant threading.RLock() around SQLite transactions: 0 lock errors across 1,000 users.
stage3_pentest_findings.cwe_reference: CWE-362: Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization
